# 有序 PDX API

`krieg-lang/pdx` 提供解析、语义比较和有序构造器。`items` 数组保留重复键与顺序；`string()` 处理普通文本，`quoted()` 保留显式转义。

## atom

Token content is literal; quoted token escape sequences remain explicit.

```ts
export declare function atom(text: string, quoted?: boolean): PdxAtom;
```

## SourceSpan

Ordered concrete PDX syntax. Objects must never be used as property maps.

```ts
export interface SourceSpan {
  start: number;
  end: number;
  line: number;
  column: number;
}
```
